review_notes: I read the whole file and the simp-tagged trace, norm and basis lemmas in Basic.lean. I found no justified simp-interface problem. The file adds no @[simp] lemmas and has no rewrite cycles or competing rules. toMatrix_algHom and det_toMatrix_algHom are only used as explicit rewrites inside the file. Marking them simp is optional, because their left-hand sides are unusual and a simp lemma on the matrix would not clearly help any existing call site. trace_algHom, norm_algHom and algHom_star need an injectivity hypothesis that simp cannot discharge, and f is a free variable. They are better left as explicit lemmas. I did not check downstream files that use these results, and I could not run Lean.
